draft.subject: Following up on our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. I wanted to check in now that you've had a few days with Wrenfield.

If it's helpful, projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting a first project in place is usually the easiest starting point. When you're ready to bring the rest of the Cedar Systems team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work to set up your first project together? Happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Priya
